divisions.title: Flight and Deliverance
divisions.theme: Running from God into the depths
divisions.summary: Jonah flees from the Lord's call, is swallowed by the great fish, and prays from the belly of Sheol.

divisions.title: Mission and God's Compassion
divisions.summary: Jonah preaches judgment, the city turns, and God reveals his heart for the nations against Jonah's anger.
